confirmed.claim: Not a direct application: managed through partner universities and NGOs (fiche description, both languages)

confirmed.claim: Decision-making is done by the partners, no central committee
confirmed.quote: The application process and decision-making are managed by our partners.

confirmed.claim: No single deadline: each partner sets its own (deadlineLabel)
confirmed.quote: Each partner in the Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program sets their own deadline.

confirmed.claim: Levels covered: secondary, undergraduate, master's; no PhD (levelLabel / eligibility[2])
confirmed.quote: provides scholarships at the secondary, undergraduate, and master’s levels. However, scholarships are not currently available to PhD candidates.

confirmed.claim: Funding: tuition, accommodation, books and scholastic materials

confirmed.claim: Funding: return air ticket to country of origin if necessary

confirmed.claim: Financial, psychosocial and academic support (fiche: soutien psychosocial, mentorat, accompagnement académique)

confirmed.claim: Application fees reimbursed if selected
confirmed.quote: the fees will be reimbursed if the candidate is selected for the Program.

confirmed.claim: Tests: SAT/TOEFL for North American partners, not required by Africa-based partners

confirmed.claim: Recommendation letters, sometimes submitted online by the referee

confirmed.claim: Admission requirements first; take tests several months ahead

confirmed.claim: Limited number of annual scholarships for international and refugee students, postgraduate, any discipline
confirmed.quote: A limited number of scholarships are available annually to international and refugee students for postgraduate study in any discipline at UCT.

confirmed.claim: Only one call per year
confirmed.quote: As there is only one call for applications each year, it is important that the application procedure is strictly followed.

confirmed.claim: Funding is partial: a supplementary contribution, and applicants must already be able to fund their studies
confirmed.quote: All UCT international and refugee students' scholarships are supplementary as a contribution towards the cost of attendance.

confirmed.claim: Applicant must have own means
confirmed.quote: Students who apply must have the means to fund their studies.

confirmed.claim: Competitive award, preference to senior candidates
confirmed.quote: These scholarships are awarded on a competitive basis, and preference is given to senior candidates.

confirmed.claim: Full-time admission application required via Admissions Office or Faculty Office
confirmed.quote: Applicants must apply for full-time admission through the UCT admissions office or the faculty office.

confirmed.claim: Country of origin irrelevant; proof of refugee status required
confirmed.quote: The applicant's country of origin has no bearing on the award of scholarships, but proof of refugee status is required.

confirmed.claim: Published exclusion: no support beyond funding tenure (3rd-year Master's and above, 4th-year Doctoral and above)
confirmed.quote: this applies to 3rd year Masters degrees and above, and 4th year Doctoral degrees and above.

confirmed.claim: Award tenure: one year Honours, first two years Master's, first three years Doctoral
confirmed.quote: Allocations are made for one year at Honours level; for the first and second years of Master’s study

confirmed.claim: Renewable subject to satisfactory progress
confirmed.quote: The scholarships are renewable for the duration of the course of study subject to satisfactory progress being maintained.

confirmed.claim: Funding applications not considered without an admission application

confirmed.claim: Full-time employment above 20 h/week makes an applicant ineligible for UCT postgraduate funding
confirmed.quote: Individuals who are employed full-time (more than 20 hours per week) are not eligible for UCT postgraduate funding support.

confirmed.claim: The online PG funding form is reserved for South African and permanent-resident applicants; international students use other forms

confirmed.claim: Research master's/doctorate: supervisor and project identified ideally 7 months ahead
confirmed.quote: Ideally, you should do this at least 7 months before you intend to begin your degree.

confirmed.claim: NRF deadlines: June/July for Master's, October for Honours
confirmed.quote: The application deadline for these awards is normally in June/July for master's degrees and in October for honours degrees.

confirmed.claim: Most UCT award deadlines before mid-November
confirmed.quote: The deadlines for most of these awards are before mid-November.

proposedEdits.newFr: Nombre limité de bourses annuelles pour étudiants internationaux et réfugiés, en postgrade et dans toute discipline à UCT, avec un seul appel par an. Deux avertissements figurent noir sur blanc sur la page officielle : ces bourses sont un simple complément au coût des études, et le candidat doit déjà avoir les moyens de financer ses études. Au 29 septembre 2026 la page n’annonce toujours aucun appel 2027 : le dernier avis publié est que l’appel 2026 n’ouvrira pas faute de financement. À traiter comme une piste secondaire, derrière le NRF et les financements de département.
proposedEdits.newEn: A limited number of scholarships is available annually to international and refugee students for postgraduate study in any discipline at UCT, with only one call each year. Two warnings appear plainly on the official page: these awards are merely supplementary as a contribution towards the cost of attendance, and applicants must already have the means to fund their studies. As of 29 September 2026 the page still announces no 2027 call: the latest published notice is that the 2026 call will not open due to funding constraints. Treat this as a secondary route, behind NRF and departmental funding.
proposedEdits.justificationQuote: The call for applications for 2026 will not open, due to funding constraints.

proposedEdits.newFr: La page officielle porte encore l’avis selon lequel l’appel 2026 n’ouvrira pas faute de financement : ne rien préparer avant d’y voir un appel 2027 publié.
proposedEdits.newEn: The official page still carries the notice that the 2026 call will not open due to funding constraints: prepare nothing until a published 2027 call appears there.
proposedEdits.justificationQuote: The call for applications for 2026 will not open, due to funding constraints.

records.notes: All five sources read (three distinct URLs + PDF handbook). The fiche's substantive claims about eligibility, tenure, exclusions, PGFO support and the general funding procedure are confirmed. The one blocking point is that the 'will not open' notice is dated to the 2026 call, and the catalogue text presents it as the state of the 2027 call. Postgraduate admission closes 30 Sept 2026 (tomorrow), which makes the fiche's step 2 urgent for anyone still intending to apply for UCT admission for 2027; the text is correct today and becomes obsolete on 1 Oct 2026.
